newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Friday amid short-covering ahead of the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers said.

"At current levels the market seems firm, but with rises in the last couple of sessions, selling is likely to resume, which may keep the index range-bounded," dealer Ali Raza Mooney of KAB Securities said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 15.54 points, or 0.99 percent, to end at 1,590.83. Gainers led losers 148 to 119. Turnover fell to 27 million shares from 41 million in the previous session.

Askari Leasing rose 2.25 rupees to 30 rupees and Faysal Bank 2.0 to 28.25. Hub Power Co rose 0.25 to 38.65 and Pakistan State Oil 3.0 to 300. PTCL rose 0.20 to 29.55. ICI Pakistan rose 0.20 to 22.85, FFC Jordan Fertilizer 0.40 to 17.60, Fauji Fertilizer 2.0 to 80 and Sitara Chemicals 2.0 to 41.
